title: AssetVersion
description: Versioned bytes or provider object, verified metadata and access policy.

asset_id.x-reference-scope: Must resolve to an authorized Asset in the owning institution.

storage_mode.description: Selects platform StorageObject or exact pinned provider resource.

storage_object_id.description: Exact platform-managed binary and custody record.
storage_object_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution and owner_resource_type AssetVersion with owner_resource_id matching this version. Required to finalize a managed version.

storage_scan_result_id.x-reference-scope: Must match the exact storage object, verified digest and current scanner policy. Required for approved managed bytes.

external_resource_map_id.description: Platform-owned mapping to an exact externally hosted provider version.
external_resource_map_id.x-reference-scope: Map is in same institution, local type AssetVersion, and local ID equals this asset version. Provider must guarantee pinned version for publication.

created_by.x-reference-scope: Must resolve to an authorized Principal in the owning institution.

x-invariants: Approved bytes and verified metadata are immutable.
Managed versions use a StorageObject and platform scan result. Externally hosted versions use a pinned ExternalResourceMap and cannot carry a managed storage object.
Approval follows the platform authoritative object or provider result. Withdrawal blocks this resource without modifying platform custody state.
Only explicitly hosted versions can use the hosted approval command. Managed bytes require a trusted platform scan verdict.
